name: Πλαζ Αλκυονίδας
evidence: No source clearly describing this specific beach was found; the only search hit described Alepochori beach 'across from the Alkyonides' (a different beach), so evidence cannot be attributed to this location.

name: Σιδερώνα
evidence: Sources conflict: described as 'ανοργάνωτη, ωστόσο υπάρχει ένα ταβερνάκι ακριβώς δίπλα', while another notes the fish taverna 'απλώνει μερικές ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω στην ακροθαλασσιά' — a few taverna sunbeds, not a fully organized beach.

name: Λουτράκι Λίμνη Βουλιαγμένης Ηραίου
evidence: The western-shore beach of Lake Vouliagmeni 'features umbrellas, loungers, and showers', and 'around the water there are small beach bars with loungers and beds'.

name: Αγία Βαρβάρα
evidence: Skoutari/Agia Varvara beach (Lakonia): 'Σε κάποια σημεία θα βρείτε ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, ενώ στην περιοχή λειτουργούν εστιατόρια και ταβέρνες' — partial sunbed coverage.

name: Αρτάνη
evidence: Only a Facebook page exists; no source describing facilities was found.

name: Βιανδίνη (Βούρκος)
evidence: Only an aggregator entry describing it as 'a small pebbly beach' ~0.23km long, with no facility information; no sunbed/bar evidence found.

name: Θυνί
evidence: The Lakonia (East Mani) Thyni is described as a 'μικρή απόμερη παραλία με βότσαλο, στα ανατολικά του όρμου του Σκουταρίου' — small, remote, no facilities mentioned (name collides with the Argolida Thyni, also unorganized).

name: Καλαμάκια
evidence: Kalamakia at Skoutari bay: 'τμήμα της είναι οργανωμένο με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες', plus toilets, showers, lifeguard base and 'αναψυκτήρια και εστιατόρια στο όριό της'.

name: Καμάρες
evidence: 'Ένα μέρος της είναι οργανωμένο, με παροχές όπως ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες', and a business listing exists for 'Kamares Beach Bar n Food - Οργανωμένη Παραλία Καμάρες Λακωνία'.

name: Καραβοστάσι Οιτύλου
evidence: Neo Oitylo/Karavostasi: 'Έχει οργανωμένη παραλία μήκους 1.200 μέτρων... θα βρείτε ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες καθώς και ταβέρνες, εστιατόρια και καφετέριες'.

name: Κυανή Ακτή
evidence: Kyani Akti Elous: 'A section of the beach is organized with umbrellas, sunbeds and showers. At the shore, visitors can enjoy coffee or food at a restaurant-refreshment facility.'

name: Λιμάνι
evidence: Limani at Elia (Monemvasia municipality): a narrow 4-5m sand strip; 'οι λουόμενοι προτιμούν να φιλοξενούνται στον λιμενοβραχίονα... στον οποίο υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες' and it is framed by cafe-restaurants — sunbeds on the jetty, not clearly an organized beach.

name: Μαρμάρι
evidence: Marmari (Tainaro, Mani): 'The first beach, located directly in front of a hotel, is organized with umbrellas, sun loungers and a bar'; the second smaller beach is free.

name: Ξιφιάς
evidence: Xifias near Monemvasia: 'On one side of the beach there are umbrellas, loungers, and a mobile canteen, while on the other side there is a beautiful taverna.'

name: Παραλία Κάτω Νησί
evidence: Kato Nisi/Panagia (Elafonisos): 'θα περπατήσετε ελάχιστα μέτρα μέχρι την πρώτη ξαπλώστρα. Η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη, ωστόσο στα δύο της άκρα έχει αρκετό χώρο για να στήσετε τη δική σας ομπρέλα.'

name: Παραλία Κότρωνα
evidence: Kotronas is called 'one of the most well-known and organized beaches in Laconian Mani': 'There are some sun loungers and showers, and there are shops for food and coffee around the area.'

name: Παραλία Μαυροβουνίου
evidence: Mavrovouni (Gytheio): 'επιλογή ανάμεσα σε οργανωμένα beach bars με ξαπλώστρες και μουσική ή πιο ήσυχα σημεία'; sunbeds free with coffee from the bars/hotels (e.g. Margo Beach hotel beach bar).

name: Παραλία Νερατζιώνα
evidence: Neratzionas (Vatika, near Neapoli): 'αμμουδερή με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες', and 'τους καλοκαιρινούς μήνες, επί της παραλίας, λειτουργεί και καντίνα'.

name: Πλύτρα - Παχιά Άμμος
evidence: Pachia Ammos at Plytra: 'οργανωμένη, αμμώδης παραλία με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες' plus beach volley court; Blue Flag awarded.

name: Πούντα
evidence: Pounta (opposite Elafonisos, by Pavlopetri): 'η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες', with cedar natural shade along the beach.

name: Καραβοστάσι (Πλύτρα)
evidence: Karavostasi next to Plytra is 'large and has an organized section with sunbeds and related amenities'; natural shade minimal; food/coffee options at Karavostasi and Plytra.

name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
evidence: Sources describe the ORGANIZED Pantazi beach between Agios Nikolaos and Agios Dimitrios, but no explicit facility evidence for the Agios Nikolaos village beach itself.

name: Βρωμονέρι
evidence: Only evidence is a 2025 municipal auction notice that a 500 sq.m. umbrella/sunbed concession space MAY be leased — no confirmation an operator actually runs sunbeds there.

name: Λιβάδια
evidence: No source about a Livadia beach in Messinia was found; all 'Livadia' results refer to Paros, Tilos, Astypalaia etc. (heavy name collision).

name: Παραλία Δελφίνια
evidence: Delfinia between Kardamyli and Stoupa: 'It is not an organized beach, although there is a refreshment stand approximately in the middle... you should come equipped with everything else.'

name: Παραλία Φονέας
evidence: Foneas near Kardamyli: 'There is no full organization with umbrellas and loungers. Usually only one canteen operates during the summer months, so it's good to bring water, shade and whatever else you need.'

name: Πεταλίδι
evidence: 'Petalidi is an organized beach with crystal-clear waters and all facilities near the village' with a promenade of tavernas and cafes; sunbeds not explicitly itemized (beach also has a Seatrac and accessibility infrastructure per our data).

name: Μούρος
evidence: Mouros (Amorgos) 'is not an organized beach with loungers — visitors are advised to bring their own loungers and umbrellas'; a taverna/café operates above the beach.

name: Κλεισίδι
evidence: 'Στο Κλεισίδι δεν υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες και beach bar' — natural shade from tamarisks; taverna Margarita and (since 2022) The Mule and the Pig operate near the beach (2023 source).

name: Ξετρυπητή
evidence: No beach-specific source found; only island-wide statements that Anafi's best beaches have 'πεντακάθαρα νερά και ειδυλλιακά τοπία χωρίς ξαπλώστρες' — generic, not attributable to this specific beach.

name: Ρούκουνας
evidence: Roukounas (Anafi): 'Η παραλία δεν διαθέτει οργάνωση επομένως δεν θα βρείτε ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες για ενοικίαση, ωστόσο υπάρχουν ντους και τουαλέτες' — cafeteria and taverna in the area, not on the beach.

name: Αγ.Κυπριανός
evidence: Agios Kyprianos (Andros) 'is listed as a non-organized but beautiful beach' with trees/rocks for shade; a small taverna operates above the beach (neighbouring Kypri, a different beach, has the sunbeds and beach bars).

name: Παλαιοπολη
evidence: Palaiopoli beach (Andros) 'is an unorganized but beautiful beach' — no loungers, umbrellas or organized facilities, unlike most west-coast Andros beaches.

name: Σιφνέικο
evidence: Antiparos.com describes Sifneiko/Sunset beach with only 'a children's playground nearby and stone benches' — no mention of sunbeds, umbrellas or a beach bar; other guides class it with the 'alternative' non-commercial beaches, but no explicit unorganized statement found.

name: Βάρδια
evidence: Vardia (Karavostasi, Folegandros) 'is not organized with sunbeds or umbrellas, and there are no sunbeds, umbrellas or beach bar available on the beach' — bring your own shade/water.

name: Κοχλίδια
evidence: Chochlidia/Karavostasi beach relies on tamarisk natural shade; guides stress Folegandros beaches are 'undeveloped tourism-wise... without plastic sunbeds and umbrellas' — no organized facilities described for this beach.

name: Λιβάδι
evidence: Livadi (Folegandros): 'The beach is not organized, so you'll need to bring water and your own beach equipment' — the adjacent camping has a restaurant/mini-market/bar, but the beach itself has no sunbeds.
